item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
item.description: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."

item.title: Opinion: Remembering Annie Dillard, nature writer
item.description: With her 1974 book, "Pilgrim at Tinker Creek," Annie Dillard became the youngest woman to win the Pulitzer Prize. We take a moment to remember her and her work.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Life in Kabul 5 years after the Taliban's return
item.description: Five years after the return of Taliban rule, NPR visited Kabul to see how Afghans are dealing with their new government's strict social restrictions.

item.title: Betel nuts are a top mind-affecting substance. Now there's evidence of ancient use
item.description: New research on ancient human remains suggests the habitual usage of betel nuts, a plant seed with mind-affecting properties that is popular in parts of Asia despite the health risks it presents.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Archaeologists are racing to save precious artifacts in Alaska after last year's storm
item.description: Last year, remnants of a typhoon damaged homes, infrastructure and an archaeological dig site. Now, archaeologists are trying to get as many objects out as possible before the next storm.

item.description: The Federal Reserve just raised interest rates this week for the first time this year. So how does it actually work? And what does it mean for the economy — and the rest of us? Here are some answers.

item.title: Russia holds parliamentary vote in areas it seized from Ukraine in the war
item.description: Russia's parliamentary election for the first time is being held in Ukraine's regions that Moscow illegally annexed after the start of its full-scale invasion more than 4 1/2 years ago.

item.title: As Europe warms, Italy sees West Nile virus spread
item.description: Italian health authorities see evidence that rising temperatures and longer warm seasons are helping mosquitoes spread West Nile virus across a wider area, during more months of the year.

item.title: U.S. and Denmark reach deal to build U.S. military presence in Greenland
item.description: President Trump says he has a deal with Denmark to bolster the U.S. military presence in Greenland. The announcement comes after months of threatening to take the island by force from the NATO ally.

item.title: Alaska's salmon-feasting bears face off in biggest Fat Bear Week ever
item.description: This year's single-elimination tournament will see 16 competitors face off, compared to 12 in past years. Officials report more cubs in Katmai National Park than they've seen in recent memory.
